summary: Comprehensive testing of Hero Phonics English learning app for kids. All backend APIs (26 tests) and frontend flows passed successfully. App features phonics sounds, words with meanings, story reading with click-to-speak TTS, admin CRUD, and progress tracking with stars.
seed_data_creation: Seeded automatically on backend startup: 26 phonics (A-Z with hero names), 16 words with emojis/meanings, 4 stories, admin user, demo kid user
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features working correctly. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_hero_phonics_api.py cover auth, phonics, words, stories, TTS, progress, and admin CRUD. Frontend tested: login/signup, dashboard tabs, phonics grid with TTS, word cards, story reading with clickable words, admin page CRUD, logout. TTS uses EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and works correctly.
